description:

  • Approved by Health Canada (REG. NO. 35004 P.C.P. ACT) *Currently only available in Canada

title: Paume Probiotic Hand Balm
description:
Our absolutely favourite hand cream ever! We have used this for years and we are so excited to be able to offer it to you now :)

Formulated for those who:

  • experience dry chapped hands
  • need added moisture throughout the day
  • seek fast absorbing non-greasy moisturizers
  • are concerned about aging skin on their hands

This rich, fast absorbing hand balm is enhanced with natural probiotics and plant based emollients that deliver long lasting hydration and improve skin tone, elasticity and texture. 

This 60ml tube is made of 75% PCR (previously recycled plastic).

description:

Available in two intoxicating aromas, you will have a hard time choosing a favourite. They make the best gift so stock up while you can!
